'''Senya Tirall's lightsaber pike''' was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-bladed [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]] wielded by [[Senya Tirall]]. Senya used this traditional [[Knights of Zakuul|Knight of Zakuul]] weapon when she investigated the site of the [[Ord Mantell massacre]] and was ambushed by her daughter [[Vaylin]].<ref name="Betrayed" />
